For the days of an incapacity, of vacation taken, of unpaid leave or suspension, and after termination, no occupational-risk contribution accrues to the employer (Decree 1072 of 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6, novelties 1.2, 1.3, 1.4 and 1.6, from Decree 1772 of 1994 art. 19 as modified by Decree 1528 of 2015). heading: Can employees and employers make additional voluntary contributions?
context: Contingent withholding information duty. For every voluntary pension fund or AFC / AVC deposit made through payroll, the employer must inform the receiving entity, when the deposit is made, of the difference between the withholding that would have applied without the contribution and the withholding
changes: Contingent withholding information duty. For every voluntary pension fund or AFC / AVC deposit made through payroll, the employer must inform the receiving entity, when the deposit is made, of the difference between the withholding that would have applied without the contribution and the withholding actually applied, computed on taxable labour income less the Tax Code art. 387 items (Decree 1625 of 2016 art. 1.2.4.1.28 for pension funds and art. 1.2.4.1.12 for AFC / AVC accounts, both as modified by Decree 2250 of 2017 art. 9). For its own voluntary contributions the employer must state in whose favour each contribution is made and the contingent-withholding amount, and deposit the contribution directly with the administrator (art. 1.2.1.22.42). The entity keeps the control account and withholds on a non-qualifying withdrawal (arts. 1.2.4.1.37 and 1.2.4.1.38). The channel and layout are set by each entity; there is no DIAN form.

context: Incapacity beyond 180 days. Days 181–540 are paid by the pension administrator as a benefit equal to the one the employee was receiving (Law 100 of 1993 art. 41, as amended by Decree-Law 019 of 2012 art. 142); from day 541 the health insurer pays, funded by ADRES, in the cases of Decree 780 of 2016
changes: Incapacity beyond 180 days. Days 181–540 are paid by the pension administrator as a benefit equal to the one the employee was receiving (Law 100 of 1993 art. 41, as amended by Decree-Law 019 of 2012 art. 142); from day 541 the health insurer pays, funded by ADRES, in the cases of Decree 780 of 2016 art. 2.2.3.6.1 (as substituted by Decree 2126 of 2023), liquidating the benefit and paying it to the employer (art. 2.2.3.4.3). The benefit is computed on the contribution base reported for the month before the initial incapacity (art. 2.2.3.3.1); increases above 40% of the 12-month average are disregarded (art. 2.2.3.4.5).

heading: Are any other kinds of leave paid by government authorities?
context: Payroll consequences. Health and pension contributions continue throughout on a base equal to the value of the incapacity, never below the statutory minimum base (Decree 780 of 2016 art. 3.2.1.10); the Tax Code art. 114-1 exoneration applies as usual; no occupational-risk contribution accrues (Decre
changes: Payroll consequences. Health and pension contributions continue throughout on a base equal to the value of the incapacity, never below the statutory minimum base (Decree 780 of 2016 art. 3.2.1.10); the Tax Code art. 114-1 exoneration applies as usual; no occupational-risk contribution accrues (Decree 1072 of 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6). The benefit is taxable (DIAN Oficio 27408 of 2019, item 7.1). The contract is not suspended, because incapacity is not among the Labour Code art. 51 causes: the days count for the service bonus, severance savings and vacation, but the benefit amount does not enter the salary average for those items (Supreme Court SL1659-2025, reiterating SL588-2024).
